title: Story premise EDU027: The Stripe Compressor Meets Confetti
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (computing/data). Hook: Can the same shortcut make one picture bigger? Takeaway/theme: Compression effectiveness depends on both the data and the encoding overhead.
description: A messenger wants to shrink an image description, but a repeated-run code that helps stripes grows bulky on alternating pixels. Comparing encoded lengths reveals when this particular compression scheme helps.
